description: Post-hoc wall-clock derivation for the exploratory live pair of Section sec:live. One row per cell per arm, carrying the duration the run itself recorded, and the aggregate the paper quotes.

provenance.timing_measurement: in-process wall clock, the difference of two time.monotonic() readings around the cell, written by the run harness into the per-cell workspace artifact
provenance.hash_encoding: sha256 over LF-normalised content, the convention benchmark/results/EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json documents
provenance.source_digest_recipe: sha256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the '<repo-relative path>:<lf-normalised sha256>' lines, sorted by path and each terminated by one LF; the per-cell source_sha256 values are that same set

pairing.rule: cells present in both arms' attack sets, keyed by (user_task_id, injection_task_id, attack_type); the same key the arms' index.jsonl rows carry
pairing.reference_cell_set: the intersection of the two arms' attack rows in their shipped index.jsonl, which is the set the paper's other live numbers are computed on

paper_claims.sentence: median cell wall time increased from 63.9 s to 73.3 s (1.15x), while aggregate wall time increased from 13,213 s to 36,948 s (2.80x), with 22/80 governed cells exceeding 600 s
